blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Police have filed a murder complaint against three suspects linked to the fatal shooting of Regional Trial Court Presiding Judge Joseph Wee Sit in Zamboanga City on Thursday. Lt. Col. Shellamie Chang, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 9 (PRO 9), said the criminal complaint was lodged before the Zamboanga City Prosecutor’s Office at around 12:36 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 14.
